definitions.gloss: to sing, to cry, to chirp, to make animal sounds
definitions.explanation: For animals, birds, or insects to produce their characteristic sounds.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}が{木|き}の{上|うえ}で{鳴|な}いている。
examples.english: Birds are singing in the tree.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が「にゃー」と{鳴|な}いた。
{蝉|せみ}が{鳴|な}いて{夏|なつ}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: Hearing the cicadas sing makes me feel summer.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair. Pattern: Xが{鳴|な}く (X [animal] makes sound).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {鳴|な}いている = 'is singing/crying.'

HOMOPHONE:
- {鳴|な}く - animals making sounds (this entry)
- {泣|な}く - to cry (humans, tears)

ANIMAL SOUNDS IN JAPANESE:
- {犬|いぬ}: ワンワン (wan wan)
- {猫|ねこ}: ニャー (nyaa)
- {鳥|とり}: ピーピー/チュンチュン
- {蛙|かえる}: ケロケロ (kero kero)
- {蝉|せみ}: ミンミン (min min)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鳥|とり}が{鳴|な}く (birds sing)
- {虫|むし}が{鳴|な}く (insects chirp)
- {蝉|せみ}が{鳴|な}く (cicadas cry)
